name: Neural Radiative Transfer via Physics-Informed Optimization
aliases: Joint Light Field and Material Optimization
Neural Inverse Rendering for Participating Media
Volumetric Inverse Rendering with Neural Radiative Transfer
definition: A method for reconstructing spatially varying optical properties (absorption, scattering, phase function) and the light field of participating media from posed RGB images, using physics-informed neural optimization to enforce the Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE) and boundary conditions.
summary: Neural Radiative Transfer via Physics-Informed Optimization reconstructs participating media by jointly optimizing neural light and material fields with local Radiative Transfer Equation constraints, avoiding independent stochastic simulations.
